us.quote: Find the right buyers, build stronger relationships, and grow your pipeline with an AI-powered sales tool built on LinkedIn's B2B network.
us.ai: Assistive AI (Account IQ, Lead IQ, Message Assist, AI search) bundled into seats; Sales Assistant agent in limited beta (unverified)
us.why: The baseline every competitor is measured against.

apollo.quote: the first fully agentic GTM operating system designed to replace legacy sales tools
apollo.ai: AI Assistant, MCP in Claude and ChatGPT, Builder Studio; agents draw on seat credits
apollo.why: Cheapest all-in-one alternative: data, sequencing, and agents from $49/seat (annual) against SN's $119.99.

zoominfo.ai: GTM.AI context layer for third-party agents plus Agent Teams; moving seats to consumption
zoominfo.why: Wants to be the data every agent runs on, the role SN's data could play. It is weak financially (NRR 89%).

cognism.ai: Read-only data MCP; AI search and research; no AI surcharge
cognism.why: Low agent threat, but it shows that "your data inside Claude" is now table stakes.

clay.quote: We're building a self-learning revenue engine.
clay.ai: Global agent, Claygents, Inbound SDR Agent; Actions plus Data Credits with unlimited seats
clay.why: The default data hub for AI-native GTM engineers, assembled from 200+ providers instead of LinkedIn.

rox.ai: Fully agentic; priced per Agent Action
rox.why: Wraps SN's account-research and monitoring use case in agents that act.

actively.quote: An AI agent for every account.
actively.ai: Per-Account Agents, Watchtower, MCP; pricing not public
actively.why: Turns account lists and alerts into autonomous per-account work.

monaco.quote: The AI native platform that replaces legacy CRM and disparate sales point solutions.
monaco.ai: Agents run TAM, outbound, and pipeline; $10k credit commit, no seats
monaco.why: Startups may never buy a seat: their whole motion runs on credits.

salesforce.quote: Every seller works alongside a team of AI agents.
salesforce.ai: Agentforce Prospecting Agent and Hunter, with bundled ZoomInfo and Apollo data; Flex Credits
salesforce.why: Can do prospecting inside the CRM without LinkedIn data. That is a disintermediation risk.

hubspot.quote: AI should be measured in outcomes, not output.
hubspot.ai: Breeze Prospecting Agent at $1 per recommended lead
hubspot.why: Sets an outcome price anchor that seat licences get compared against.

commonroom.quote: Complete buyer intelligence that turns intent into pipeline.
commonroom.ai: RoomieAI agents, MCP; seats plus research and Prospector credits; now part of Zoom
commonroom.why: Person-level signals backed by Zoom's conversation data aim at SN's buying-signal moat.

usergems.quote: The AI Command Center for Outbound and ABM
usergems.ai: Gem-E agents through MCP; unlimited users with an ROI guarantee
usergems.why: Automates SN's job-change and champion alerts into campaigns.

unify.ai: Rep-level outbound agents, network-based selling; $20–60/seat plus credits
unify.why: The most direct attack on all three moats, at a fraction of SN's price.

outreach.quote: Agentic AI Platform for Revenue Teams
outreach.ai: Agent suite, MCP Server and Client; seats plus AI credits
outreach.why: An SN partner that is building its own research agents and Relationship Maps.

salesloft.quote: Turn buyer signals into action with Salesloft's AI Predictive Revenue System.
salesloft.ai: AI agents and a signals layer after the Clari merger; pricing not public
salesloft.why: Consolidating engagement and forecasting. Moderate signal overlap.

gong.ai: Custom Agents and Revenue Harness, bundled into licences
gong.why: Mostly post-meeting. Its conversation data is a context moat SN lacks.

lusha.quote: B2B Data and AI Prospecting for GTM Teams and AI Agents
lusha.ai: MCP on every plan including free; credit pricing
lusha.why: Free contact data inside Claude and ChatGPT, plus an extension that overlays LinkedIn.

seamless.quote: Best AI Sales Software & Business Leads Platform
seamless.ai: MCP server, AI Fields, Autopilot add-on; credits
seamless.why: High-volume SDR data with a LinkedIn social-selling extension.
